'''Tom Strother''' (GEMP handle '''tom'''; also published as '''GEMP Tom''')<ref name="g7-wrap" /><ref name="coth5" /> won the [[2023 Seventh Annual GEMPC]], defeating [[Mike Kessling]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="g7-wrap">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/gemp-tom-captures-7th-gemp-match-play-championship-title/ GEMP tom Captures 7th GEMP Match Play Championship Title], starwarsccg.org (5 May 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261024140801/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/gemp-tom-captures-7th-gemp-match-play-championship-title.html?copy=2 Internet Archive]</ref>
